def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    net_worth = 1_200_000
    residency_factor = 0.9

    tax_free_threshold = 500_000
    second_threshold = 1_000_000
    second_rate = 0.02
    top_rate = 0.04

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    second_bracket_tax = (second_threshold - tax_free_threshold) * second_rate
    top_bracket_tax = (net_worth - second_threshold) * top_rate
    total_tax = second_bracket_tax + top_bracket_tax
    adjusted_tax = total_tax * residency_factor

    # return answer
    return round(adjusted_tax)
